description: Forced six-step at duty 0.083, chosen so the current vector matches the FOC legs at about 0.53 A. Angle is forced, so this isolates the commutation scheme from the angle source.
notes: Matched-current leg of the three-scheme sweep on the small bench motor (flux 0.937 mWb, 7 pole pairs).
Ripple well resolved: 25 samples per 6x-electrical ripple period.
title: Six-step (trapezoidal), 101 rad/s el
